node: Grid construction, specialty utility services, EPC execution, and skilled labor capacity
summary: Layer 1B expands the universe for the grid-services/EPC/labor-capacity node. The reference anchor is Quanta Services because it defines the scale and evidence pattern: record Electric backlog, craft-skilled workforce, and transmission/grid program exposure. The underfollowed lane contains smaller US-listed contractors and engineering-service firms where the bottleneck may show up as backlog conversion, labor productivity, master-service-agreement depth, substation/interconnection work, storm restoration, and margin sensitivity to fixed-price execution. This is research support only, not a trading recommendation.
